preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and len(line) <= 1e5)
preconditions.description: Each non-empty line (excluding digit-only lines) has exactly one string of length ≤ 10^5, representing either the row or column terminal outcomes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 1e5 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) <= 1e5)
preconditions.description: All integer inputs (T, N, M, Q, x, y) are between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= M for line in stdin.splitlines() if ' ' in line and (x, y) := tuple(map(int, line.split())))
preconditions.description: Each query (x, y) satisfies 1 ≤ x ≤ N and 1 ≤ y ≤ M, where N and M are the dimensions from the current test case.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and len(line) > 0)
preconditions.description: Terminal outcome strings consist only of '0' (win) or '1' (lose) characters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == M if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and ' ' not in line and line.strip().isdigit() == False else len(line) == N for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit() and ' ' not in line)
preconditions.description: The first terminal string has length M (columns), and the second has length N (rows).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == ''.join(['1' if (x, y) in winning_positions else '0' for (x, y) in queries])
postconditions.description: For each query (x, y), the output character is '1' if Alice wins from (x, y) and '0' if Bob wins, where winning_positions are all (x, y) where the current player can force a win using optimal play.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == sum(int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and ' ' not in line and int(line) == Q)
postconditions.description: The output string has exactly Q characters, one for each query in the current test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line) == Q for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each test case's output is a single line of length Q.

postconditions.expression: all(winning_positions := set(), all((x, y) in winning_positions or (x, y) not in losing_positions for (x, y) in queries), all((x, y) in losing_positions or (x, y) not in winning_positions for (x, y) in queries))
postconditions.description: The game outcome for each (x, y) is determined by dynamic programming: a position is losing if both (x-1, y) and (x, y-1) are winning, and winning otherwise, with terminal conditions given by the input strings.
